title: Two habeas cases from the 1890s
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

compare.title: In re Medley (1890)
compare.text: A prisoner held in solitary confinement under a law passed after his crime was ordered discharged from that confinement.

compare.title: In re Bonner (1894)
compare.text: A prisoner sentenced to serve a year in a state penitentiary, where the law did not allow it, could obtain habeas relief so the court could correct the sentence.
